name: checkbox-group
description: Several independent choices under one label, such as notification channels or interests, where the user may pick any number. Compose the parts inside CheckboxGroup: CheckboxGroupLabel, one Checkbox (from the checkbox component) per option with a value, CheckboxGroupDescription and CheckboxGroupError (renders only while the choice is invalid). onChange reports the checked values and the form submits each under the group's name. For one on/off choice use a single checkbox; for exactly one of several use a radio-group.

props.name: ref
props.description: The wrapping element, which has the group role.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; the form submits each checked value under it.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled checked values; pair with onChange.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with every checked value after each change.

props.name: orientation
props.description: vertical stacks the checkboxes; horizontal puts them in a row, for short labels only.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Requires at least one checked value before the form submits.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Prevents changes and dims every checkbox.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Marks the choice invalid from outside, e.g. after a server error.

props.name: validate
props.type: (value: string[]) => string | string[] | true | null | undefined
props.description: Returns an error message for an invalid choice, shown by CheckboxGroupError.

props.name: validationBehavior
props.description: native validates on form submit; aria validates as soon as the choice changes.

example:
<CheckboxGroup name="notify" defaultValue={["email"]}>
  <CheckboxGroupLabel>Notify me by</CheckboxGroupLabel>
  <Checkbox value="email">Email</Checkbox>
  <Checkbox value="sms">SMS</Checkbox>
  <Checkbox value="push">Push</Checkbox>
  <CheckboxGroupDescription>You can change this later.</CheckboxGroupDescription>
</CheckboxGroup>
